critical_code_review_comments: App.js is 651 lines and still contains Gate + AuthGate + VerifyBanner + AuthModal + all pages in a single file. Recommend splitting auth components into src/components/auth/*.jsx for maintainability.

AuthGate stores password in the same form state used for reset (form.password) — after reset, password field is cleared but nickname/email persist; acceptable but could be clearer with separate state per view.
VerifyBanner: 'resendCode' has no throttle indicator/countdown in UI; server returns 429 as text — good, but adding a disabled state with countdown after click would improve UX.

AuthModal (old flow at line 58) is still present but Gate blocks the site so AuthModal is never reached from an unauthenticated state. Dead code path — safe to remove now or keep for future 'action requires auth' hooks (requireAuth still calls setModal('login')).

Token in localStorage AND httpOnly cookie both set — belt-and-suspenders. If cookie is httpOnly + secure, the localStorage copy is only used to prime the Authorization header on refresh; consider unifying to cookie-only to reduce XSS surface.
AuthGate resets password field to '' after reset-password but keeps email — UX ok; login form auto-fills email, user just types new password.
